title: Reports similar pieces of code.
summary: It is an experimental (alpha) checker, so the analyzer does not run it by default. It applies to C, C++, Objective-C.

title: Check for cast from non-struct pointer to struct pointer.
summary: It is an experimental (alpha) checker, so the analyzer does not run it by default. It applies to C, C++.

title: Loss of sign/precision in implicit conversions.
summary: It is an experimental (alpha) checker, so the analyzer does not run it by default. It applies to C, C++, Objective-C.

title: Check for dereferences of pointers that refer to an object whose lifetime has already ended.
summary: Such a pointer is dangling. The checker reports it when it is dereferenced and when it is passed to a function. It is an experimental (alpha) checker, so the analyzer does not run it by default. It applies to C, C++.

title: Check for pointer arithmetic on locations other than array elements.
summary: It is an experimental (alpha) checker, so the analyzer does not run it by default. It applies to C.

title: Check for writes to immutable memory regions.
summary: This implements part of SEI CERT Rule ENV30-C. It is an experimental (alpha) checker, so the analyzer does not run it by default. It applies to C, C++.

title: Check for division by variable that is later compared against 0.
summary: Either the comparison is useless or there is division by zero. It is an experimental (alpha) checker, so the analyzer does not run it by default. It applies to C.

title: Check for returned pointers and references that are bound to an object whose lifetime ends when the function returns.
summary: The checker only analyzes code that is annotated with the [[clang::lifetimebound]] attribute. The annotation tells the checker which object the returned value is bound to. It is an experimental (alpha) checker, so the analyzer does not run it by default. It applies to C, C++.

title: Check unreachable code.
summary: It is an experimental (alpha) checker, so the analyzer does not run it by default. It applies to C, C++.

title: Check for an out-of-bound pointer being returned to callers.
summary: It is an experimental (alpha) checker, so the analyzer does not run it by default. It applies to C.

title: Simple lock -> unlock checker.
summary: Applies to: pthread_mutex_lock, pthread_rwlock_rdlock, pthread_rwlock_wrlock, lck_mtx_lock, lck_rw_lock_exclusive lck_rw_lock_shared, pthread_mutex_trylock, pthread_rwlock_tryrdlock, pthread_rwlock_tryrwlock, lck_mtx_try_lock, lck_rw_try_lock_exclusive, lck_rw_try_lock_shared, pthread_mutex_unlock, pthread_rwlock_unlock, lck_mtx_unlock, lck_rw_done. It is an experimental (alpha) checker, so the analyzer does not run it by default. It applies to C.

title: Checks for overlap in two buffer arguments.
summary: Applies to: memcpy, mempcpy, wmemcpy, wmempcpy. It is an experimental (alpha) checker, so the analyzer does not run it by default. It applies to C.

title: Check for out-of-bounds access in string functions, such as: memcpy, bcopy, strcpy, strncpy, strcat, strncat, memmove, memcmp, memset and more.
summary: It is an experimental (alpha) checker, so the analyzer does not run it by default. It applies to C.
